summary: This is a Form 6-K filing of a foreign private issuer reporting a routine press release of quarterly financial results for Q2 2026. Brookfield Wealth Solutions announces strong second quarter results including total assets of $205.7 billion, distributable operating earnings of $488 million, and completion of the acquisition of Just Group plc. The filing contains no special-situation event; it is a standard earnings disclosure with operational highlights. There are no terms of an offer, tender, spin-off, or other corporate action that would qualify as a special situation. The merger with Brookfield Corporation is mentioned as a previously received shareholder approval item, but not detailed in this filing.
